strongest_angle: Investigative findings reveal that Deloitte Cyprus and Meritservus falsified at least 1,000 corporate papers and backdated records to help Roman Abramovich hide hundreds of millions in assets and evade taxes.

key_facts.fact: Deloitte Cyprus and its spin-off Meritservus falsified at least 1,000 corporate papers on behalf of Roman Abramovich.
Accounts signed off by Deloitte in Cyprus meant assets such as superyachts, mansions and private jets worth $672m vanished from Roman Abramovich's control.
Deloitte staff used fake timestamps to rewrite the historical record before acting as independent auditors to sign off accounts for Roman Abramovich's firms.
Aides of Roman Abramovich, including staff at global accountancy firm Deloitte Cyprus, falsified paperwork mapping the oligarch's offshore business empire.
